newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Eureko Ireland launches new finance company.
newsitem.headline: Eureko Ireland launches new finance company.

text.p: Eureko Ireland on Friday launched a new finance company, Eureko Ireland Finance, and said the new company was being set up to generate profitable income from asset financing and related activities in the lending market.

Eureko Ireland Finance will offer low cost leasing and personal loan facilities along with a flexi-payment service to Eureko's customers and eventually the wider market, Eureko Ireland said in a statement.
Once established as a competitive player in the market, the new company will develop other options for customers such as credit cards, mortgages and deposit facilities.
The establishment of Eureko Ireland Finance marks the first step by an Irish insurance company into banking.
"Customer needs are changing as is the financial services market," Eureko Ireland managing director Adrian Hegarty said.

"The move is towards having all your insurance and banking needs looked after under one roof and with the continued growth of Eureko in Ireland we will progressively offer our clients a comprehensive and innovative portfolio of financial services products."
Eureko Ireland is the Irish division of the pan-European Eureko Alliance and the parent company of life and general insurers Friends Provident and Celtic International.
